selection_decision.reason: Geometry has the strongest observed pairwise ordering in both source-aligned modes and is the smallest deterministic policy supported by the currently accessible outcomes.

sources.transformation: Skills/evaluate_field_ranking_policy.py v3 feature records; source_aligned_ztf_i41=true and eligible=true; pairwise ROC AUC computed independently by src/calibration.py

validity.freshness_rule: Recompute when either source envelope, searched-null ledger, feature definition, or eligibility contract changes.
limitations: The ieo comparison is small at 7 positive and 7 searched-null records.
The geometry preference peaks were revised using these same accessible outcomes, so the component comparison is retrospective and optimistic.
The searched-null sample is not a randomized survey-control sample.
AUC measures ordering on recorded outcomes, not absolute candidate quality or expected discovery yield.
